Name: Four Seasons Greenhouse (CP)
Author: yuninocorn
Description:
[b][size=4]General
[/size][/b]
[b]The Map[/b]
The Four Seasons Greenhouse map includes planting sections for all four seasons (this is for aesthetic purposes, any crop can be planted anywhere), a large island section in the middle and processing sections to the north, east, south and west, where you can process your crops in any way you want, including aging your produce in casks. You can also plant fruit trees on the edges of the island section in the darker colored sand.

[b]Farm Building[/b]
The Four Seasons Greenhouse can be constructed as a farm building by Robin. The price can be adjusted with Generic Mod Config Menu. Here's a price list for the different config options:

Default: 500,000g, 50 gold bars, 20 clay, 600 wood, 500 stone

Cheap: 100,000g, 20 gold bars, 10 clay, 200 wood, 300 stone

Expensive: 1,000,000g, 100 gold bars, 50 clay, 999 wood, 999 stone

Capitalist: 5,000,000g, 500 gold bars, 100 clay, 999 wood, 999 stone

You can also enable a snowy winter texture for the building's exterior through GMCM, as well as different conditions to unlock the building (completing the CC/Joja, unlocking the greenhouse, achieving full shipment). If you have one of these enabled, you will receive a letter from Robin once the building is unlocked for construction.

[b]Greenhouse Replacement[/b]
You can also enable this map as a greenhouse map replacement with Generic Mod Config Menu. I recommend doing this with a new greenhouse or clearing your old one if you want to use it for an existing save, as your old crops/machines may be stuck in the walls otherwise.

[b]Minecarts[/b]
The greenhouse replacement map includes small side rooms with minecarts for each seasonal section, as well as the four processing rooms. These minecarts allow you to quickly travel between rooms, so you don't have to spend half your day walking. This is the only difference between the farm building map and the greenhouse replacement map (I couldn't get the minecarts to work for the farm building).

[b][size=4]Compatibility[/size][/b]
The map itself doesn't use any custom tilesheets, so interior reclors should apply. The farm building exterior does not have recolor options available as of right now.

[size=4][b]Permissions[/b][/size]
If you want to make your own recolor/retexture, translation, or make any other kind of change to this mod and post it, you are free to do so and use my assets, as long as your mod is an add-on (using my mod as a dependency) and doesn't just copy/replace this one. Please only use my assets for the things you are changing.

Enjoy!
